reason: Having quit another meal delivery service before, Document A wins me over with concrete operational details—like the ability to swap meals, the 4-week menu cycle, the no-contract policy, and the offer of a 15-minute phone call with the actual dietitian—while being completely transparent about the small A1C sample size. Document B leaves in generic placeholders like '[Service Name]' and lacks the practical details about menu variety and cancellation that I need to trust a paid trial.
